Author: Anomaly
Name: Pet Service
Description: A private FFXIV tool for consensual pet/master roleplay and power dynamics. Masters manage messages and reminders through Discord or a private portal, while pets receive interactive prompts in game. Includes replies, snoozing, shared status and location, and a local kill switch controlled by the pet.
Punchline: Consensual pet/master roleplay, messages, and shared routines.
Changelog:
- Larger master-message prompts with native chat access improvements.
- Choose and report a custom snooze duration.
- Confirm kill-switch activation from any plugin screen or command.
- Queue Discord notices for kill switch and local safe mode.
- Request the master’s attention with /petservice request.
- Pet-local daily schedules and master-local display times.
- Ordinary FFXIV chat is never stored or forwarded.
